test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

ABANDON
solution: The correct answer is **'Support' (**समर्थन देना या सहायता करना)**.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **ABANDON** means to give up completely, or to stop looking after someone (अनचाही वस्‍तु को पूर्ण रूप से त्‍यागा या छोड़ा हुआ). • **Example: **The air bombings forced the villagers to abandon their homes. • The **antonyms** of the word **ABANDON**: **support**, retain, withhold, reclaim. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's have a look at the meaning of other given words: • **Abhor:** to feel hatred or loathing for a way of behaving or thinking (अत्‍यधिक घृणा करना). • **Agree:** to have the same opinion about something or concur (किसी बात या व्‍यक्ति से सहमत होना). • **Abolish:** to formally put an end to a system, practice or an institution (किसी क़ानून या प्रथा को आधिकारिक रूप से समाप्‍त करना). 38:T7db, The correct answer is** "eager"**
